examples.name: Sample — RenewablesDeploymentTracker2024_p13
paragraphs: Six titled panels — five bar panels (World, China, European Union, United States, India) over the same five years, and one horizontal panel (Avoided emissions) over regions — every bar printing its value: 30 values in six tables. Each single-series panel is headed by its value-axis title (GW, Mt CO₂). China appears both as a panel and as a row of the avoided-emissions panel; each table's title keeps them apart. The bar values are printed in bold. The running header and tab label are elided.

examples.name: Sample — two panels sharing a legend and an axis
paragraphs: Two bar panels stacked vertically, each with its own underlined period caption (1960–1973, 1973–1980), over one rotated axis title on the far left and one legend that serves both. Each panel is its own table, and both tables carry the three legend series as their headers: read alone, the lower panel's bars are unnamed. The axis title, printed once, is kept once. Every bar prints its value; the printed minus signs are written -. The lower panel runs negative, bars descending below a zero line that crosses the panel. In the lower panel, the value label under Marolia's second bar is covered by the bar itself and that bar is drawn both above and below the zero line, so the Marolia row is elided. The running header is elided.

examples.name: Sample — sixteen small panels under two captions
paragraphs: Figure 3a and Figure 3b hold eight stacked-bar panels each, every panel headed by its deposition type and its element's flux title, each drawing ten stacks of four fill colours. No panel prints a site name, a tick value or a legend, so no bar can be located or calibrated: the panels carry no chart table, and the output keeps their printed headings and titles, in reading order. Figure 3b and the text below it are elided.

examples.name: Sample — recession bands behind four lines
paragraphs: Four line styles, each named by a direct label with a leader line, over 33 years (1970–2002, the axis labeling every second year as 1970, 72, 74 …) and five grey vertical bands that the note says are recessions. The four named series are the table's columns; the bands are reference ink and add nothing to it, while the note that explains them is kept. No value is printed, so every cell is an estimate against the 2-point grid. Only the first two labeled years are shown; the table continues through 02, and the table sharing the page is elided.
